text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends stop control for minor streets at seven uncontrolled three-way intersections in the Milford Haven Drive area in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Greenock Avenue at Milford Haven Drive (north intersection). 2. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Milford Haven Drive at Greenock Avenue (south intersection). 3. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Tralee Avenue at Milford Haven Drive (east intersection). 4. Authorized compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Tralee Avenue at Milford Haven Drive (west intersection). 5. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Ingrid Drive at Milford Haven Drive. 6.
